strings.en: The alien Inspectors, who attacked the Earth Sphere...
Neue DC, an army that rose against the Federation...
Shadow Mirror, a covert unit in league with them...
And the mysterious bio-weapons, the Einst.
Their main forces were crushed by the Federation's
battleship Hagane, the Hiryu Custom, and the Kurogane.
fighting ended, and the Earth Sphere began to regain peace.
The Earth Federation Government, learning from its
repeated battles with aliens, resolved to bolster the
As part of this, manufacturers were asked to develop
a new mainstay to succeed the Mass-Production Huckebein Mk-II,
that they had been moving since the Inspector Incident's end.
Now, the bell of a new war was about to toll.
Settling in near Earth, the Sodean
deployed a strange barrier around itself.
The Federation struck at the Sodean
Army could only leave the Sodean alone.
Then the Shura struck across Earth.
Their chaotic, savage way of fighting
left the Federation Army reeling and losing ground...
